attributes.name: Blessing of Wind and Waves
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

Discard this card to explore your location. 

Display this card next to a location. While displayed, add 2 dice to checks to close this location. When this location is closed, recharge this card and a random card from your discard pile.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Gozreh trait, you may examine the top card of up to 2 location decks.
